nodes.title: MiniMax Director
widgets_values:
# Muse Minimax Director

## Mode
- **Reference (Omni)** — multi-character/video/audio references, soft-followed
- **First/Last Frame** — Ref 1 = first frame, Ref 2 = last frame, locked exactly

## Generation
- **Total Duration** — the finished length
- **Chunk Size** — length of each single MiniMax call (auto-splits above ~15s)

## Resolution
- **Aspect Ratio / Megapixels** — output size
- **Multiple Of** — leave alone unless you know why you're changing it

## Sampling
- Standard sampler controls
- **Shift (video) / Shift (audio)** — advanced, leave at default

## Reference Settings
- **Ref Image Size** — "match" is faster, "max" is stronger identity but slower
- **Dialogue Language** — feeds every spoken line
- **Hybrid Continuation** — multi-chunk only, needs a First/Last-Frame model wired in

## Overall Style
One or two sentences setting the look of the whole clip — lighting, palette, camera feel.

## Soundscape & Music
- **Overall Soundscape** — ambience/physical sound
- **Non-Diegetic Music** — background score only the audience hears
- Blank or `N/A` if not needed

## Characters / Location
- Drop an image into **Ref 1–9** for each character, **Location** for the setting
- Type a description or click **Analyze**
- **Retention** — how strictly it's followed; leave on `fully preserved` unless intentionally blending

## Ref Video
*(optional)*
- **Subject description** — blank = pure motion/camera reference; fill in if a person/thing should be reused
- **Role** — Reference / Editing source / Continuation source
- **Include this clip's audio** — also pulls its sound in as a voice reference

## Ref Audio
*(optional)*
- A short voice sample + whose voice it is
- **Retention** — `reference` clones the voice/style; `fully copy` reuses the actual audio

## Timeline / CUTs
- One CUT per beat — drag block edges to change pacing
- Put `"quoted text"` in a CUT for dialogue — a **Speaker** dropdown appears

## Referring to things in CUT text

nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds per single generation call.

## Links
- [MiniMax H3 on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3 (ComfyUI-ready weights)](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)
- [Muse Minimax Director on GitHub](https://github.com/muse-collective-26/MiniMaxH3-Director)
- [MiniMax H3 official prompt-writing guide](https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/docs/VIDEO_PROMPT_WRITING_GUIDE_ref_en.md)

## About this workflow

This workflow runs MiniMax H3's **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task through **Muse Minimax Director**, a timeline-based director node that sits on top of the stock `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. Instead of manually writing `<Picture N>` / `<Video N>` / `<Audio N>` tags into a single prompt box, you build a script visually:

- Drop up to 9 character images into **Ref 1-9** and a **Location** image, write a description for each (or click **Analyze**)
- Write your script as a sequence of **CUTs** along the timeline, and tick who's speaking on each one
- Optionally add reference video and reference audio - Ref Audio N automatically becomes Ref N's voice

Muse Minimax Director compiles all of that into MiniMax H3's own official reference-mode prompt format - six sections (`subject_definitions`, `summary`, `retention_analysis`, `detailed_description`, `overall_soundscape`, `non_diegetic_music`), with every `<Subject N>` / `<Picture N>` / `<Video N>` / `<Audio N>` tag numbered exactly the way H3 itself assigns them, and long scripts automatically split into multiple chunks if they exceed a single ~15 second generation call. Check the node's `compiled_prompt` output any time you want to see exactly what was sent to H3.

**Sampling**: `res_multistep` sampler; `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one.

Full documentation: [github.com/muse-collective-26/MiniMaxH3-Director](https://github.com/muse-collective-26/MiniMaxH3-Director)

widgets_values:
## Model Links

### Standard MiniMax H3 Models

[🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

**vae**

- [minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors)
- [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors)

**diffusion_models**

- [minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) — standard Reference/Omni model, wired into `model`
- [minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) — First/Last Frame model, wired into `model_fl2va`

**text_encoders**

- [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors) — standard MiniMax H3 text/vision encoder


### Lower-VRAM GGUF Option

[🤗 MiniMax-H3 Curve GGUF](https://huggingface.co/joeygambino/MiniMax-H3-curve-GGUF)

**diffusion_models**

- [MiniMax-H3-ref2va-curve-Q4_0.gguf](https://huggingface.co/joeygambino/MiniMax-H3-curve-GGUF/resolve/main/ref2va/MiniMax-H3-ref2va-curve-Q4_0.gguf) — quantized Reference/Omni model

[🤗 MiniMax-H3 Encoder GGUF](https://huggingface.co/joeygambino/MiniMax-H3-encoder-GGUF)

**text_encoders**

- [MiniMax-H3-encoder-Q4_K_M.gguf](https://huggingface.co/joeygambino/MiniMax-H3-encoder-GGUF/resolve/main/MiniMax-H3-encoder-Q4_K_M.gguf) — quantized MiniMax H3 text encoder
- [MiniMax-H3-encoder-mmproj-F16.gguf](https://huggingface.co/joeygambino/MiniMax-H3-encoder-GGUF/resolve/main/MiniMax-H3-encoder-mmproj-F16.gguf) — required multimodal projector for reference images

The GGUF encoder and matching `mmproj` file must remain together in the same folder. Do not rename either file.


### Turbo LoRA

[🤗 lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo](https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo)

**loras**

- [minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo/resolve/main/minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors) — MiniMax H3 Turbo acceleration LoRA used by this workflow


### Preview Models

[🤗 Kijai/MiniMax-H3-TAE](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-TAE)

**vae_approx**

- [taeh3.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-TAE/resolve/main/vae_approx/taeh3.safetensors) — optional MiniMax H3 sampling preview model

**vae**

- [taeltx2_3.safetensors](https://github.com/madebyollin/taehv/raw/main/safetensors/taeltx2_3.safetensors) — lightweight preview VAE used by the workflow's preview utilities


## Model Storage Locations

- `ComfyUI/models/vae/`
  - `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors`
  - `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors`
  - `taeltx2_3.safetensors`

- `ComfyUI/models/vae_approx/`
  - `taeh3.safetensors`

- `ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/`
  - `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`
  - `minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`
  - `MiniMax-H3-ref2va-curve-Q4_0.gguf`

- `ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/`
  - `qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors`
  - `MiniMax-H3-encoder-Q4_K_M.gguf`
  - `MiniMax-H3-encoder-mmproj-F16.gguf`

- `ComfyUI/models/loras/H3/`
  - `minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_comfyui_bf16.safetensors`


## GGUF Loader Requirements

The optional GGUF route requires:

- [ComfyUI-GGUF](https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF) — provides `Unet Loader (GGUF)`
- [ComfyUI-H3-Multishot](https://github.com/joeygambino/ComfyUI-H3-Multishot) — provides the MiniMax-aware `H3 CLIP Loader (safetensors + GGUF)` and MiniMax H3 GGUF compatibility support

For the H3 CLIP loader:

- Set `type` to `minimax`
- Select `MiniMax-H3-encoder-Q4_K_M.gguf`
- Select `MiniMax-H3-encoder-mmproj-F16.gguf` as the matching projector


## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare the required models.

- Issues with **Muse MiniMax Director** itself—the timeline UI, chunking or compiled prompt: [MiniMaxH3-Director/issues](https://github.com/muse-collective-26/MiniMaxH3-Director/issues)
- Cannot run or runtime errors in ComfyUI core or the stock MiniMax H3 nodes: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI/frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
